topic: Analytics dashboard updates and naming conventions
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered the readiness of tooltip assets, with [p1] confirming that the files were ready for use. Later, a naming convention issue was raised regarding analytics graphs. It was decided that the graph titled 'Dwell time' should be renamed to 'Dwell Time distribution'. A separate chart, 'Frequency Distribution', was noted as being specifically prepared and only appeared in the tooltip text, while the 'Dwell Time Distribution' title had previously only been mentioned in the tooltip text.

[me] deployed updates to the staging analytics environment at multiple points during the day.
decisions: The graph name 'Dwell time' must be changed to 'Dwell Time distribution'.
